summary: Implemented and verified a CI-native exact-snapshot executor for frontier-pressure compilation. GitHub Actions run 35271966001 checked out the explicitly recorded SHA 92cc63b95eb0169605821ea9d33d8fe4201aee8a, verified HEAD equality, ran the persisted compiler bytes under Node with exit 0, uploaded artifact evidence, and reconciled portfolio-exclusive-job-pin-live-race-2-v1 against its durable pin/claim/job-scoped-heartbeat/PARTIAL-return refs. The canary independently expected REPLACEABLE at 68.304 minutes and the compiler reported both replaceable=true and claimable=true. Failure paths are fail-closed and covered by regression tests. No product authority was promoted. During post-claim validation this worker also exposed a separate fast-path contract gap: the initial atomic pin create omitted mandatory metadata because /wc permits claiming before loading the full pin contract; the pin metadata was immediately reconciled with Git-history-preserved original bytes, and a bounded successor was materialized so future fast claims do not require post-create repair.
tests: local Node v22.16.0: 3/3 frontier-pressure exact-snapshot executor tests passed
